items.title: Zama spin-off Raycash launches confidential stablecoin payments and private yield on Ethereum
items.teaser: Raycash has launched its app on Ethereum, enabling private stablecoin payments and Morpho yield on idle balances.

items.title: SpaceX proposes a $24 billion Texas supercomputer worth 17 times its bitcoin pile
items.teaser: The $24 billion project, which includes an AI supercomputer in Texas with its own gas-fired power plant, is about 17 times the value of SpaceX's bitcoin holdings.

items.title: Solana moves to scrap the transaction feature used in the $270 million Drift hack
items.teaser: A draft proposal would end the 'durable nonces' feature no earlier than May 5, 2027, forcing custodians that sign offline to rebuild how they move coins.

items.title: Two rival Ethereum proposals aim to stop Glamsterdam breaking old contracts
items.teaser: The proposals aim to keep Ethereum’s planned gas changes from breaking existing contracts, using different approaches to what contracts see and what users pay.
